meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: The same ratios over the new GDP series (2022-23 base), 2022-23 on: what the deficit and debt look like against the larger or smaller economy the new series measures
meta.note: Computed here: the RBI's rupee figures over GDP at current market prices on the 2022-23 base (gdp-2022-annual-levels). The RBI still divides by the 2011-12 series. The Centre's 2025-26 figure is its revised estimate and the states' 2024-25 theirs, over the NSO's estimate of that year's GDP; budget estimates are left out (they assume a GDP the NSO has not measured).
